resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit status413 is handled before JSON/body access; primary and recovery poisoned-body controls pass, retaining dedicated failure type without additional classifier requests.

Four guest-specific neutral texts show escaped BOT and TARGET, expressly assign the ban button to caller and state that invocation is not proof of malicious intent. Existing mention helper is reused; failure falls back to exact ID mentions. Missing caller remains non-actionable.

delta_review.plan: Exactly two specified replacements; no unrelated contract changes.
delta_review.new_helper_behavior: Known guest may use the existing member lookup helper for BOT/TARGET before ATTEMPTED; failed name lookup preserves exact IDs, and replay does not repeat the notice or name lookups.

independent_validation.v1_controls_scope: Original9file snapshot only; preserved, not claimed as current rerun.
independent_validation.current_delta_scope: 4 independent lookup-fallback/replay controls, 2 primary/recovery parser guards, 4 guest identity/HTML escaping regressions, 2 actual moto Decimal ban target/counter regressions.

maintainability_assessment: SpamRepository decision/lease/input_hash/source_ref remains sole owner; no extra table, queue, scanner, retry owner or independent moderation state system.
413 produces review failure metadata only; no invented label/confidence, automatic enforcement, CLEAN or outbox creation.
ATTEMPTED is persisted before notification. Ambiguous sends or state writes remain ATTEMPTED/UNKNOWN and suppress automatic resends, including after membership changes.
send_message defaults remain None retries and False confirmation; only new413 path opts into retries=False/strict full-envelope acknowledgement.
Persisted target validation accepts finite integral Decimal and true positive int, rejecting missing/self/mismatch/malformed targets before action selection/effects.
Existing admin/cross-chat/lease/selected_action/enforcement counter and ordinary reviewed CLEAN/source_ref versus guest ignored remain intact.
unresolved_out_of_scope: Existing non413 review notifications may still retry on ambiguous delivery; their protocol was not changed.

No cross-service exactly-once guarantee between provider, DynamoDB and Telegram. ATTEMPTED/UNKNOWN does not guarantee administrator visibility or eventual manual resolution; original30day TTL and no scanning/resend remain.
Actual provider account limit remains UNKNOWN; this source change does not repair the provider limit or establish live413 outcomes.
Full-suite, CI, ARM and dev/prod deployment/readback are separate parent-owned evidence gates; no claim of their completion here.
